component.name: Randomix
component.summary: Choose randomly between numbers, answers, options and so on

description.p: Randomix is an open source app to choose randomly between numbers, answers, options and so on. It packs four tools in one window:

ul.li: Roulette: spin between custom options, a number range, letters, numbers 1-100 or a deck of cards, with a recent sets list.
Coin: a plain heads or tails flip.
Dice: throw one to ten dice of type D4, D6, D8, D10, D12 or D20, or play 3 vs 3.
Magic Ball: ask a question and get a random answer, with optional rude answers or your own custom answers.

description.p: The app remembers the last used tool, supports light, dark and Amoled themes, twelve accent colours and an animated blob background.
This is a Linux desktop port of the Android app Randomix by m.i.n.a.r, released under the MIT license.
Choose the roulette spin animation in the settings: a wheel with a centre readout, a cover flow of cards, or the option chips lighting up in turn.
First Linux desktop release: the four randomizers, recents, presets, themes and settings.
